intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Eagan for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The season runs from November 26 (Magic of Lights at Viking Lakes, through January 2) with the Community Tree Lighting at the Eagan Community Center (December 1), Old Fashioned Holiday at Holz Farm (December 6), Caroling, Cocoa and Cookies at Chapel Hill Church (December 9) and the Noon-Years Eve Dance Party (December 31) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Eagan

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Eagan
  • 2 free events: the Community Tree Lighting and Caroling, Cocoa and Cookies at Chapel Hill Church
  • Meet Santa: Mr. and Mrs. Claus at the Community Tree Lighting and Santa and his reindeer at Old Fashioned Holiday at Holz Farm
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Eagan Community Tree Lighting on December 1
  • Lights: Magic of Lights drive-through display at Viking Lakes through January 2
  • Season: November 26 to January 2, 2026 to 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Eagan families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Minneapolis, which covers the Orpheum and Guthrie holiday shows, the CPKC Holiday Train, Christkindl Market and the Minnesota Streetcar Museum.
